name: json_python_literals
description: Translate Python True, False, and None to their corresponding lowercase JSON literals, with key-copy control.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
vals=[True,False,None]
for i in range(96):
 v=vals[i%3];key=random.choice(['active','value','status','result','enabled','ready','valid','option'])
 p=f'Convert the Python value in {{"{key}": {v!r}}} to JSON. '
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Write only the JSON value, without quotes. Value:', 'answer':' '+json.dumps(v)})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Write only the dictionary key, without quotes. Key:', 'answer':' '+key})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
